name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Tram-based metro termini and a through station with a pedestrian underpass.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.9.0 adds a prototype Metro Through Station: two 80m side platforms, ordinary electric tramtrack connections at both ends, two street-side pedestrian entrances and native rail-station stair assets for a pedestrian underpass. Through lanes use ordinary directional tram modes without reservation flags. The underpass paths and terrain holes are adapted from native modern railway platforms; no extra train infrastructure is required. Existing terminus resource IDs and layouts are retained. Shared surface decoration prepares the station family for future configuration; selectable lengths, types and platform counts are not implemented yet. New station placement, routing, pedestrian stairs, boarding and persistence require in-game validation. Speed investigation remains separate. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
